sql: SELECT t.created_at, t.market_ticker, t.side, t.assumed_price::text AS price, t.quantity::text AS qty, t.status, coalesce(t.fees::text,'-') AS fees, coalesce(t.pnl::text,'-') AS pnl, coalesce(t.fill_assumption,'-') AS fill_assumption FROM paper_trades t WHERE t.strategy = 'Alimm1_pt3' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 20
